caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case that is reddish-brown in color. The clock is vertically oriented, featuring a rectangular body with a wider base supported by four bracket feet. The lower portion has an inset panel with an oval decorative element in the center, framed by a thin golden border. Above this is a central section with a door, also with a rectangular panel and an oval motif, and a small keyhole near the right edge. The top section houses the clock face, which is circular with Roman numerals and two hands, set within a square frame. The face of the clock is white with black numbers and hands, and an inscription in the center. Above the clock face is a decorative arch with painted scenery, including clouds and sky. The top of the case is topped with a curved, crown-like ornament. The background of the drawing is plain and light in color, with no additional objects or details present. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Hall Clock (Miniature)
